title: US FEG is a proud supporter of Team Gleason.
subtitle: There is NO CURE for ALS. Until there is a Cure, There is Team Gleason.
mission: Since 2011, Team Gleason, founded by Steve Gleason, has provided over $55 million in adventure, technology, equipment, and care services to people living with Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) and countless others through advocacy, support and ultimately bringing an end to the disease.

campaign.title: Step Up and Out for Gleason Gras
campaign.lead: Team Gleason is challenging our US FEG partners-in-mission to Step Up and Out for Gleason Gras 2025!
paragraphs: If US FEG affiliated companies collectively meet a goal of $50,000, we will host a private Patron Party for US FEG members with a very special musical performance, food, wine, and special branded cups.
Get involved as a Patron Sponsor for $5K, or as a Black and Gold Sponsor at $10K. All it takes is 10 sponsorship commitments at Patron Level of $5K to unlock your private party with a purpose!
campaign.quote: At Team Gleason we believe there is strength in relationships. When we come together, we’re able to make a bigger impact for the ALS community.
